Class ModuleIOTalonFX

java.lang.Object
com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve.ModuleIOTalonFX
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModuleIO
public class ModuleIOTalonFX extends Object implements ModuleIO
Module IO implementation for Talon FX drive motor controller, Talon FX turn motor controller, and CANcoder. Configured using a set of module constants from Phoenix.

Device configuration and other behaviors not exposed by TunerConstants can be customized here.
